text: Alliance About & Governance 4️⃣ CHERI for seL4 WG 4️⃣ CHERI for seL4 WG Coordinates work at the intersection of CHERI capabilities, seL4, Microkit, verified kernels, and capability-oriented system design. The CHERI for seL4 Working Group focuses on the integration and combination of the two technologies. The objectives of the seL4 WG are: Consolidate existing efforts trying to port seL4 to CHERI Coordinate open-source development efforts around CHERI-seL4* Have a single CHERI-seL4 (kernel) to reduce confusions with upstreaming and the seL4 community Sync updates, events, demos, etc. around CHERI-seL4 Please note that CHERI-seL4 is experimental and isn’t formally verified or upstream yet.
